About Cazcanes Tequila
Cazcanes Tequila is an award-winning ultra-premium tequila brand built on authenticity, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising commitment to quality. Produced using traditional methods, certified organic agave, and natural spring water, Cazcanes has earned a reputation as one of the fastest-growing luxury tequila brands in the United States.
As we continue to expand nationally and internationally, we're looking for a collaborative, creative, and execution-focused Brand Manager to help bring our brand to life across every consumer and trade touchpoint.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Brand Manager is responsible for executing the Cazcanes brand strategy across consumer, trade, and experiential marketing channels. This role serves as a key member of the marketing leadership team, partnering closely with Sales, Brand Advocacy, Operations, Creative partners, and distributors to deliver marketing initiatives that build brand awareness, deepen consumer engagement, and support commercial growth.
The Brand Manager will translate strategic priorities into exceptional execution by managing integrated marketing campaigns, trade marketing programs, experiential activations, packaging initiatives, CRM programs, and sales enablement tools. This role requires a strong blend of creativity, organization, collaboration, and commercial thinking, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

Brand Marketing
Execute integrated marketing campaigns across consumer, trade, experiential, digital, and partnership channels.
Partner with the Chief Marketing Officer to execute annual brand marketing plans that support company growth objectives.
Manage the annual marketing calendar, ensuring campaigns, product launches, partnerships, and activations are delivered on schedule.
Ensure brand consistency across all marketing materials and consumer touchpoints.
Monitor consumer trends, competitive activity, and market insights to identify opportunities that strengthen the brand.
Trade Marketing & Sales Enablement
Develop marketing programs and sales tools that support distributors and the commercial team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
Represent Cazcanes at distributor meetings, customer events, industry conferences, and consumer activations.
Support budget planning and manage assigned marketing initiatives to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

They are highly organized, commercially minded, and passionate about building premium brands through exceptional storytelling and consumer experiences. They thrive in entrepreneurial environments, build strong cross-functional relationships, and take pride in delivering thoughtful, high-quality work that drives measurable business results.

Du willst nicht nur Kampagnen optimieren, sondern Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln, Budgets verantworten und Kunden als echter Sparringspartner begleiten? Dann bist du bei altitude richtig.
Als digitaler Growth Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, Wachstum messbar, effizient und nachhaltig voranzutreiben. In deiner Rolle verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz und arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.
Aufgaben
Performance-Strategie & Wachstum
Gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam entwickelst du passende Wachstums- und Performance-Marketing-Strategien für unsere Kunden.
Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele in konkrete Kanal-, Kampagnen- und Budgetstrategien über relevante Online-Marketing-Kanäle hinweg, darunter Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Native und Programmatic.
Du steuerst Budgets kanal- und zielgruppenübergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Maßnahmen effizient auf die definierten Wachstumsziele einzahlen.
Du analysierst laufend Performance-Daten, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und passt Strategien regelmäßig an.
Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und weitere Anwendungen, um Analysen, Recherchen, Kampagnenkonzepte, Reportings und operative Prozesse effizienter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.
Kampagnensteuerung & Marketing Operations
Du verantwortest das Setup, Management und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Du etablierst Reporting- und Controlling-Prozesse, überwachst relevante KPIs und behältst Budgets, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
Du übersetzt Kundenziele in klare Aufgaben für das Performance-Team und gibst strukturierte Briefings.
Du bist Impulsgeber für aktuelle Performance-Marketing-Themen, neue Tools und AI-basierte Arbeitsweisen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv im Team.
Kunden, Stakeholder & Zusammenarbeit
In Kundenterminen und Jour Fixes präsentierst du Performance-Strategien, Maßnahmen und Ergebnisse verständlich und überzeugend.
Du stellst sicher, dass Kunden Anforderungen, nächste Schritte und Performance-Hebel jederzeit nachvollziehen können.
Du erkennst Potenziale, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam konkrete Maßnahmen zur Zielerreichung.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative Team zusammen, um datenbasierte kreative Konzepte, neue Testansätze und wirkungsvolle Kampagnenideen zu entwickeln.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing gesammelt, idealerweise im Agentur-, E-Commerce-, B2C- oder B2B-Umfeld.
Du kennst dich in mehreren Online-Marketing-Kanälen gut aus, zum Beispiel Paid Social, Paid Search, Native oder Programmatic, und hast in mindestens einem Kanal echte Expertentiefe.
Du hast Erfahrung mit Tracking, Reporting und KPI-basierter Kampagnensteuerung.
Du triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und verbindest analytisches Denken mit pragmatischer Umsetzung.
Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.
Du verfolgst Performance-Marketing-Trends aktiv und bringst neue Impulse proaktiv ins Team ein.
Du managst deine Projekte proaktiv und selbstständig, findest dich aber auch schnell in Teams ein und schätzt Kollaboration und gute Zusammenarbeit.
Du arbeitest analytisch, detailorientiert und strukturiert.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und gestaltest Wachstumsstrategien aktiv mit.
Interdisziplinäres Expertenteam: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Kollegen aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.
Moderne Ausstattung: Technisch aktuelles Work Equipment ist für uns selbstverständlich. (MacBook)
Mobilität: BVG-Zuschuss oder Swapfiets-Abo. Du kannst entscheiden
Erholung: Wer neue Wege geht, braucht hin und wieder eine Pause. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr.
Weiterentwicklung: Eigene Projektverantwortung, große Handlungsfreiheit und der Erfahrungs- und Wissensschatz unseres Teams sorgen dafür, dass du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Desweiteren wirst du regelmäßig an Fortbildungsveranstaltungen teilnehmen, um in der Online Marketing Welt immer auf dem neusten Stand zu bleiben.
AI-enabled Workflows: Wir arbeiten aktiv mit modernen Tools und Technologien, um bessere Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Teamkultur: Erfolge zu feiern und als Team zusammenzukommen ist uns wichtig. Deshalb schaffen wir regelmäßig Raum für Austausch, Lernen und gemeinsame Teamevents.

Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt.
Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen.
Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe.

Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing mit messbaren Ergebnissen , idealerweise im E-Commerce/D2C.
Sehr gute praktische Klaviyo-Kenntnisse (oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Plattform). Du denkst in Customer Journeys und verstehst Retention-Mechaniken (Rebuy, CLV, Churn).
AI-native Arbeiten ist für Dich selbstverständlich : Du setzt LLMs, n8n, Cursor und ähnliche Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein.
Du baust selbst : Flows, Segmente und Templates entstehen in Deinen Händen. Du bringst sie eigenständig live, lernst aus Ergebnissen und iterierst schnell.
Segmentierung, Trigger, A/B-Tests und Deliverability beherrschst Du sicher.
Mit Consent und Datenschutz (DSGVO) gehst Du selbstverständlich sauber und verantwortungsvoll um.
Du bist datengetrieben und übersetzt unsere Looker-Dashboards in konkrete Maßnahmen.
Kreatives Gespür: Du setzt ein Briefing aus dem Nichts auf und bringst eine Kampagne mit einer starken Hookline auf den Punkt. Du verstehst den Zusammenhang zwischen Creative und Performance.
Kategorie-Empathie für Copy und Creative : Du kannst Dich in die Perspektive von Tierhalter:innen hineinversetzen - und das zeigt sich in Deiner Ansprache.

Who we are
Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

As a Product Marketer, you will develop the positioning, narratives and materials that make Helsing's products clear and credible to customers, partners and decision-makers. This asks for a thorough understanding of our technology across both hardware and software, and the craft to translate it. Your work will directly inform how governments and defence customers understand Helsing.
The day-to-day
Develop and maintain core marketing materials — positioning statements, one-pagers, messaging frameworks and sales enablement kits
Embed yourself with our Product, Programmes and Campaigns teams to turn technology capabilities into product narratives that land with each audience
Collaborate closely with Communications, Events and Content teams to develop authentic product stories
Lead go-to-market for new capabilities and product updates, including sequencing, messaging, moments and materials
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify differentiation, emerging trends and new opportunities
You should apply if you
Have delivered product marketing in a technology environment — including owning a launch end-to-end, with the artefacts and outcomes to show for it
Can translate complex or technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without losing accuracy or substance — and have writing samples that demonstrate this
Have moved into an unfamiliar technology or product area and got up to speed quickly, without needing close supervision
Have built trust with cross-functional teams — product, engineering and customer-facing
Are fluent in English and German, written and spoken
Are motivated by Helsing's mission to protect democratic societies, and ready to engage with the responsibility that comes with it

Familiarity with the defence, aerospace, robotics or government sectors
Willingness and ability to travel periodically to our European offices
Note: This position may require the successful applicant to apply for and be granted security clearance.
Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital.
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individuals are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.
A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking

Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).
Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.
This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.
You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.
As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence.

You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't.

Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.
The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.
Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
What you'll be doing
Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.
Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.
Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.
Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.
Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.
Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.
What you'll need to have done
Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.
Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.
Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.
Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.
Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.
Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

Job Title: Product Marketing Director - Platform and Partner Ecosystem

We are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Director to join our Portfolio Marketing team within the Marketing division.

This role will lead our Platform and Partnership Go-To-Market (GTM) launch efforts, managing a cohesive brand and partnership strategy that positions interoperability and integrated partners as a vital driver of customer value and platform strength.

The Director will support scalable growth across our business, enhance our ecosystem value, and unlock new revenue opportunities for athenahealth .
The Director will manage a cohesive athenaConnect brand that positions interoperability and integrated ecosystem partnerships as a vital driver of customer value and athenahealth differentiation. As a key member of a cross-functional team, this individual will bridge connectivity between product, marketing, sales, service delivery, and the Partnership commercial teams.
This position will oversee product marketing for our interoperability platform and integrated partner solutions, focusing on product positioning, messaging, and commercial enablement programs to empower our commercial teams to effectively communicate the value of our market-leading integration capabilities to a broad audience spanning the healthcare ecosystem, including providers (ambulatory practices and health systems), payers, risk-bearing entities, and other ecosystem partners.

This includes developing cohesive messaging that highlights the unique value of our network and partner ecosystem for each market segment. In this role, the Product Marketing Director will support the growth of athenahealth ’s multi-tier partnership program, developing partner-facing messaging and leading integrated partnership launches.
This role reports to the Vice President of Portfolio Marketing.

The Portfolio Marketing team supports athenahealth ’s commercial go-to-market strategy through market research, competitive intelligence, persona development, messaging and positioning, collateral development and enablement, and product launch oversight.

We strive to deepen our understanding of our customers and their needs to create positioning and value propositions that evoke action.

Acting as the storytellers of athenahealth , our team collaborates across the organization to ensure that commercial teams have the knowledge and content necessary to create demand, win new business, and drive growth within our customer base.

Own product marketing for the Athena Connect interoperability suite: Craft a cohesive and differentiated message to support articulation of athenahealth ’s interoperability and integration capabilities, marketed across the ecosystem to providers, payers, health systems, developers, and other ecosystem partners.
Curate partner ecosystem positioning and value messaging: Develop and expand provider-facing messaging and positioning that articulates the value of athenahealth ’s integrated partner network.
Lead high impact product and partnership launches Oversee the launch of new products and partnerships, from messaging and positioning through commercial enablement, and guide matrixed teams supporting launch efforts with clear communication and strategic leadership - ensuring alignment with commercial goals and market needs.
Competitive Analysis: Work with internal competitive intelligence teams to inform analysis of competitors' interoperability products, strategies, and market positioning to inform differentiation and GTM strategies.
Commercial Enablement: Equip commercial teams with the necessary knowledge, content, and tools to effectively communicate product value and drive sales.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a liaison between product, marketing, sales, service delivery, and the Partner Marketing team to ensure effective product positioning and launch execution. Work in close partnership with Partner Marketing, which will lead partner campaigns, marketplace promotion, co-marketing, and activation programs.

Bachelor’s Degree required; degree in business, marketing, or communications preferred.
10+ years of professional experience marketing within the healthcare IT / EHR industry.
5+ years of experience in product marketing, managing product launches, and developing messaging and enablement programs.
Strong familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and frameworks (e.g., HL7/FHIR, USCDI, EDI) and a working understanding of the broader interoperability landscape is required.
Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, translating market insights into actionable marketing strategies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Strong leadership skills, with comfort leading across both direct and matrix teams.

Hochwertige frische Schokolade - dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.
In unserem Unternehmensbereich «Corporate Functions» sind verschiedene Tätigkeiten gebündelt. Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.
**Das erwartet dich**
* Du entwickelst und steuerst saisonale Retail-Marketing-Kampagnen für über 250 Stores weltweit und übersetzt globale Brand- und Marketingstrategien in kommerziell erfolgreiche In-Store-Erlebnisse
* Du verantwortest Projekte von der Idee über Konzeption, Prototyping und Produktion bis zum internationalen Rollout und verbindest dabei kreative, kommerzielle und operative Anforderungen
* Du arbeitest eng mit Product Marketing, internationalen Märkten sowie externen Agenturen, Lieferanten und Produktionspartnern zusammen und führst komplexe Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig zum Erfolg
* Du begleitest internationale Märkte bei saisonalen Aktivierungen, Neueröffnungen und Retail-Initiativen und entwickelst Lösungen, die lokale Anforderungen mit einem konsistenten Premium-Markenerlebnis verbinden
* Du analysierst Feedback aus den Stores, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmassnahmen ab und entwickelst Kampagnen, Visual-Merchandising-Konzepte sowie Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter
* Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres globalen Store-Konzepts und überträgst dieses auf unterschiedliche Retail-Formate wie Flagship Stores, Kioske oder Shop-in-Shop-Konzepte
**Das bringst du mit**
* Du verfügst über einen abgeschlossenen Bachelor in Marketing, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich und begeisterst dich für Retail Marketing sowie In-Store-Kommunikation. Ein paralleles Masterstudium soll dich nicht von einer Bewerbung abhalten
* Du bringst erste Berufserfahrung in Marketing, Retail oder Projektmanagement mit und hast ein gutes Gespür für markengerechte sowie kommerziell wirksame Umsetzungen
* Du überzeugst durch starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und eine hohe Detailorientierung, um mehrere Themen parallel strukturiert und zuverlässig zu steuern
* Du verfügst über fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und arbeitest gerne in einem internationalen Umfeld
* Du zeichnest dich aus durch Eigeninitiative, Verlässlichkeit und eine Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Motivation, Themen aktiv voranzutreiben und erfolgreich umzusetzen

* Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen
* Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

* Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

* Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte
* Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

The Marketing Specialist (MarTech Manager) serves as the strategic lead for the Air Force Services (AFS) Non Appropriated Fund (NAF) marketing technology ecosystem, including the enterprise CMS, eCommerce, analytics, and related digital platforms.

Provides governance, product ownership, and enterprise coordination to ensure digital platforms directly support revenue-generating business units and enterprise marketing objectives.

Identifies capability needs and modernization opportunities based on analytics, user feedback, and mission requirements. Maintains product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

Develops and maintains digital governance, including publishing standards, access roles, workflow rules, content lifecycle requirements, and digital compliance practices. Provides guidance to installations and program offices on interpreting and applying governance standards.

Ensure platform requirements remain aligned with enterprise technical and security frameworks in coordination with technical stakeholders. Leads development of Statements of Work (SOWs), technical requirements, and evaluation criteria for MarTech services, and coordinates with Procurement teams for contract execution, renewals, and modifications.

Monitors vendor performance and ensures deliverables meet requirements and support revenue-producing operations. Ensure installations can effectively use digital platforms to promote programs, drive participation, and support business unit performance. Communicates platform changes, updates, and requirements across the AF MilMark Network.
